title: Choose the Reefscape RL shell
question: The look stays Neuron’s glossy header, lifted tabs, and cream plates. The roll picks how the trainer is arranged. Keep that arrangement, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Shared field grid
options.lineage: Carpet tape, drawn in Neuron’s chrome. The brief pinned Neuron, so the blue carpet becomes the cream plate and the tape becomes the blue grid.
options.thesis: Train, status, and the field sit on Neuron chrome, and the reward chart uses the same cream grid as the field.
options.viewport: Glossy Reefscape RL header, Train tab lifted, launch form beside a named phase list, then the chart and a small field on one shared grid. The active scoring face is the bright mark. A missing-deps warning stays on screen.
options.risk: The 2009 chrome gets noisy if every plate shouts at the same volume.

raised.raise: Every phase and model row carries a name and one status line.
The current phase shows elapsed work as a filled length.
The status chip and the step and reward numbers flip when they change.

options.label: Manual figure
options.thesis: The field is a captioned figure, and the rest of the trainer is the notes under that figure.
options.viewport: A large field figure fills the first screen, captioned with step, coral, and time. Train controls sit in a narrow note column. Tabs stay plain.
options.risk: This is the familiar documentation layout, and it sets the Neuron chrome aside.

options.label: Gate board
options.lineage: A boarding pass beside a live gate board
options.thesis: The running job is a row that stays lit until the change has been seen.
options.viewport: A status band names the job, device, and step in fixed segments. Below it, phases are rows. The CUDA warning stays amber until Setup + Deps is the next action.
options.case: Clearer when a run changes under you. Weaker as a picture of an FRC field.
options.risk: The airport board can crowd out the field.

options.label: Phase line
options.lineage: A transit diagram, used only as the phase route
options.thesis: Setup, pretrain, PPO, field, and checkpoint are stations on one line, and the train is the station that is lit.
options.viewport: A single route sits under the title: Environment, Heuristic, PPO, Field, Checkpoint. PPO is lit. The launch form and log sit beneath it as ordinary controls.
options.case: The pipeline is readable at a glance. The map is not how this team pictures the field.
options.risk: A full transit mural would stop being a trainer. This card keeps one line only.

options.label: Character roster
options.thesis: Models as a cast of mascots.
options.case: A mascot roster does not read as a training tool, and an FRC team does not see itself in it.
options.risk: The product disappears into the cast.
options.kept: Every row keeps a name and one status line.

options.label: Dance score
options.thesis: Training time read upward as a dance score.
options.viewport: A center staff with duration blocks.
options.case: Students do not read this notation, and the staff is not a trainer they can operate.
options.kept: Elapsed work has a visible length.

options.label: Season folio
options.lineage: A botanical folio of fixed-scale plates
options.thesis: Five life-stage plates at one scale.
options.case: A folio is not the working product. The shared baseline is the only part that helps.
options.risk: The trainer becomes a picture book.
options.kept: The field and the chart stay on one scale.

options.label: Split-flap board
options.thesis: Every status is a row of flipping letters.
options.viewport: A black flap board of training rows.
options.case: The board is an instrument costume. A flip on the status chip is the part worth keeping.
options.risk: The whole screen becomes a departure board.
options.kept: A changed number is an event, not a silent swap.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A light training console: side navigation, white panels, one blue action, a chart on top.
canonCard.viewport: Left rail for Train, Field, Models, and Logs. The main column leads with step, reward, and fps, then the launch form.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from a generic training dashboard by design.
